name: issue-opened
instruction: Triage this issue as a report from a user. Before deciding severity, find out how many people are affected — that is what PostHog is granted to you for. An eloquent report of something one person hit is not high severity, and a terse report of something hundreds hit is.
filter_instruction: Run only when an issue is opened or reopened and describes a problem, a regression, a crash, a data issue, or a broken workflow. Skip labels, assignments, closes and edits. Skip feature requests, questions, and issues opened by a bot.
